title: A NATO jet shoots down a suspected stray Ukrainian drone over Estonia
body:
On 19 May 2026, a Romanian jet taking part in the Baltic air policing mission shot down a suspected Ukrainian drone over Estonia. Estonian Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur described it as the first such case involving a NATO fighter. He said the drone was likely of Ukrainian origin and was aimed at targets in Russia. It was downed between Vortsjarv and Poltsamaa in central Estonia and crashed in a field. A search for debris began, and no casualties were reported.

Ukraine's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Heorhii Tykhyi apologized to Estonia and the Baltic states, and Ukraine accused Moscow of deliberately redirecting Ukrainian drones into NATO territory. Pevkur said Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov also apologized and noted that Estonia had not authorized any use of its airspace except by allies.

Russia's Defense Ministry reported downing more than 300 Ukrainian drones overnight on 19 May, including over the Yaroslavl, Moscow and Novgorod regions. Latvia and Estonia issued drone alerts around noon, and Latvia reported a single drone over its territory. Russia's intelligence service claimed that Ukraine was preparing drone launches from Latvian bases, an allegation rejected by Latvian President Edgars Rinkevics and by Tykhyi.
